New: CI now passes, and the author added a second fixture for the event-subscription form of the payload. Missing: The PR has no "Fixes: #N" and links no issue, so we can't confirm it is an approved "help wanted" issue. The author has no merged PRs.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm follow up. If no issue with "help wanted" turns up, this becomes a close candidate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for fixing the CI failures! Could you link the issue this addresses by adding "Fixes: #N" to the PR description? We only accept PRs for issues labeled "help wanted" (see the [contributing guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html)), so if there isn't one, please open an issue to discuss first.
```
